question: Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Vivek is third to the right to Kamal. Kamal is second to the right of Sanjay. Ram is second to the right of Anil. Anil is second to the right of Vivek. Rahul is third to the right of Aakash. Who is third to the left of Anil?
solution:
Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Vivek is third to the right to Kamal and Kamal is second to the right of Sanjay.
